objective: Implement and verify the producer-first Java 21 slice for the frozen continuous OKX BTC-USDT trades/books5 forward diagnostic. Refactor the current bounded V1 collector into shared deterministic parsing and aggregation primitives, preserve its behavior, add all frozen V2 minute fields, generate canonical bundle and envelope bytes, and model fixed-input continuous UTC rollover and fail-closed reconnect/restart behavior without deployment, network execution, Server Canonical intake, or a second research lifecycle clock.

Extract and reuse one package-private deterministic collector core. Do not copy the full existing parser/aggregator into the continuous CLI. Freeze production to the public OKX endpoint, BTC-USDT, trades/books5, UTC, forward-only, no credentials, no raw persistence/backfill, 14 future contiguous days, agora-evidence-source, and frozen source/day/diagnostic/drop contracts. Publish only if the prior day has exactly 1,440 contiguous minutes, at least one trade and one books5 sample in every minute, both channel acknowledgements, CLEAN integrity, zero anomalies, valid predecessor binding, canonical payload seal, and the frozen 14-day window position.

Canonical drop output must be compact UTF-8 JSON with recursively sorted keys and no trailing newline for both the complete bundle and envelope. Compute size and SHA-256 from those exact bytes. Write to a source-private staging path, force bytes, then use an exclusive atomic move into a microstructure-only drop. Reject existing targets, symlinks, overwrite, non-atomic fallback, hash drift, read-back dependence, candle path reuse, or caller-selected destination.

Identical duplicate handling belongs to the later intake, not the producer. The producer never overwrites or republishes an existing day. It cannot read Server Canonical state or the published drop after delivery.

Any disconnect that creates an unproved interval, missing stream/minute, malformed/exchange error, regression, crossed book, active-window process restart, or publication failure must fail the entire frozen window closed with no backfill or automatic start-day shift.

The orchestrator must never enqueue, select, retry, schedule, or time research actions. The sole Codex Cloud Ops schedule remains the only research lifecycle clock. Service supervision is not implemented in this task.

Add deterministic offline tests for current V1 projection, V2 field calculations, canonical full-document bytes, exact hashes, UTC rollover and next-day message retention, reconnect without structural loss, reconnect/gap failure, missing trades, missing books5, malformed/anomaly failure, fixed production inputs, exclusive atomic publication behavior through a fake sink, and restart fail-closed semantics.
